rows.grounds: location where the tantra is present
past participle of sthā indicating presence
demonstrative and noun fused in the given token

items.question: What protective quality does the presence of this tantra confer upon a household?
premises: A household may have this tantra situated within it.
This tantra is characterized as removing fear.
The presence of the tantra in a house is the stated condition.
items.inference: Therefore, a household in which this tantra is present possesses a fear-removing protection.
uncertainties: The consequence of this condition may be elaborated in subsequent verses.
items.plain_english: O goddess, in whose house this fear-removing tantra is situated.
